name: Gelihast
summary: Gelihast is a ferocious, twin-blade wielding murloc chieftain residing in the Pool of Ask'ar within Blackfathom Deeps. Surrounded by his Blindlight murlocs, he guards a strange altar in the flooded ruins of the sunken temple.

sections.title: A Deadly Calling
sections.body: While most murlocs stay near coastal shallows, Gelihast has claimed a lair deep in the sunken temple of Blackfathom Deeps beneath the Zoram Strand. Wielding twin swords with blinding speed, he cuts down intruders before they can react, and casters who stray into his reach rarely survive.

sections.title: Master of the Blindlight
sections.body: Gelihast rules the Pool of Ask'ar, surrounded by his Blindlight brood, who swarm to his side at the first sign of trouble. Beyond his lair stands an altar; those who defeat him and touch it receive the Blessing of Blackfathom.

faq.answer: Gelihast is a vicious murloc chieftain who commands the Blindlight tribe inside the Pool of Ask'ar in Blackfathom Deeps. He fights with twin blades of blinding speed.

faq.q: Why is Gelihast inside Blackfathom Deeps?
aliases: why is there a murloc in bfd
why is gelihast in the temple
faq.answer: No one knows what first drew him there. He and his Blindlight murlocs have claimed the Pool of Ask'ar in the flooded ruins, and he defends it savagely against all intruders.

faq.q: How did the Twilight's Hammer react to him?
faq.answer: Nothing is recorded of dealings between Gelihast and the Twilight's Hammer cultists deeper in the temple. He rules his own pool with his Blindlight murlocs.

faq.q: What is the altar behind Gelihast?
faq.answer: An altar stands beyond his pool. Travelers who defeat him can touch it to receive the Blessing of Blackfathom.

faq.q: What tribe of murlocs does he lead?
faq.answer: He leads the Blindlight murlocs, an aggressive tribe that infests the Pool of Ask'ar within the caverns.

faq.q: What happens to Gelihast if he is left unchecked?
faq.answer: He and his Blindlight murlocs keep the Pool of Ask'ar closed to anyone seeking to venture deeper into the sunken temple.

angles.text: Gelihast attacks with blinding sword speed; skilled warriors who brace themselves can turn his frantic dual-wielding assault entirely against him.
For Alliance forces seeking to cleanse the corruption leaking into Ashenvale, removing Gelihast is essential to secure the northern passages of the submerged temple.
Horde adventurers dispatched to scour Blackfathom Deeps must eliminate Gelihast to clear the way deeper into the sunken temple beneath the Zoram Strand.
